tools.name: civic_gene_variants
tools.description: All variants of one CIViC gene (by CIViC gene id), fully paginated — complete even for genes with hundreds of variants.

tools.name: civic_get_assertion
tools.description: One CIViC assertion by id: an expert-curated summary claim (AMP/ASCO/ CAP tier, ACMG codes, FDA companion test flags) aggregating evidence items for a molecular profile in a disease/therapy context.

tools.name: civic_get_evidence_item
tools.description: One CIViC evidence item by id: clinical significance of a molecular profile in a disease/therapy context (evidence level A–E, type, direction, significance, rating, disease, therapies, source).

tools.name: civic_get_molecular_profile
tools.description: One CIViC molecular profile by id (variant combination that evidence/ assertions attach to), incl. parsed name and component variant ids.

tools.name: civic_get_variant
tools.description: One CIViC variant by its CIViC variant id (details incl. aliases, variant types, feature/gene linkage).

tools.name: civic_search_assertions
tools.description: Search CIViC assertions by any combination of filters; fully paginated and count-verified, sorted by ascending assertion id.

tools.name: civic_search_diseases
tools.description: Search CIViC disease records by name substring (e.g. "melanoma").

tools.name: civic_search_evidence
tools.description: Search CIViC evidence items by any combination of filters; fully paginated and count-verified, sorted by ascending evidence id.

tools.name: civic_search_genes
tools.description: Find CIViC gene records by exact Entrez symbol (e.g. "BRAF").

tools.name: civic_search_molecular_profiles
tools.description: Search CIViC molecular profiles by name substring (e.g. "BRAF V600E").

tools.name: civic_search_therapies
tools.description: Search CIViC therapy records by name substring (e.g. "vemurafenib").

tools.name: civic_search_variants
tools.description: Search CIViC variants by name substring (e.g. "V600"), optionally scoped to a CIViC gene id.

tools.name: clingen_actionability
tools.description: ClinGen clinical actionability curations: for disorders associated with a gene, whether early intervention in pre-symptomatic carriers is actionable (intervention/outcome pairs with severity, likelihood, effectiveness, nature-of-intervention scores and the total score).

tools.name: clingen_dosage_sensitivity
tools.description: ClinGen dosage sensitivity curations: haploinsufficiency and triplosensitivity assertions for genes (and optionally ISCA genomic regions such as recurrent CNV regions).

tools.name: clingen_gene_validity
tools.description: ClinGen gene-disease validity curations (classification of how strong the evidence is that variation in a gene causes a disease: Definitive, Strong, Moderate, Limited, Disputed, Refuted, No Known Disease Relationship).

tools.name: clingen_variant_classifications
tools.description: ClinGen Evidence Repository (ERepo) expert-panel variant pathogenicity classifications (VCEP interpretations under ACMG criteria).

tools.name: open_targets_disease_drugs
tools.description: Known/investigational drugs for a disease (Open Targets Platform).

tools.name: open_targets_disease_targets
tools.description: Top associated targets for a disease, ranked by Open Targets overall association score.

tools.name: open_targets_drug
tools.description: Drug details by ChEMBL id (Open Targets Platform).

tools.name: open_targets_graphql
tools.description: Run an arbitrary GraphQL query against the Open Targets Platform API (https://api.platform.opentargets.org/api/v4/graphql): targets, diseases, drugs, target-disease association scores, evidence, tractability, safety, known drugs, etc.
